scripts.verify: bun run wasm && bun check && bun fmt --check && bun run lint && PROPERTY_RUNS=10000 bun test --timeout 60000
scripts.wasm: wasm-pack build server/stam-core --target nodejs --out-dir ../../.wasm/stam-core --release --no-pack -- --features wasm && wasm-pack build server/stam-room --target nodejs --out-dir ../../.wasm/stam-room --release --no-pack -- --features wasm
scripts.test:parity: bun run wasm && PROPERTY_RUNS=10000 bun test --timeout 60000 tests/parity
scripts.verify:server: cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace && bun run test:worker
scripts.dev:worker: bun run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply stam --local && wrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.deploy: bun run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply stam --remote && wrangler deploy
